name: app-food-ordering-arc-menu-in-hands-large
title: Food ordering app with arc category selector held in both hands
whatItIs: A close-up of two hands holding a phone. The screen has a large 'Hungry? Order & Eat.' title, search with a black filter button, a curved arc of circular category images, food cards with discount tags and prices, and a black pill tab bar with an orange home button.
whatItMeans: Appetising and easy; the curved arc adds motion and playfulness to browsing.
techniques: Arrange categories along an arc to add rhythm.
Use white cards with cut-out food photos and small black discount tags.
Contrast a black floating nav with an orange active icon.
Photograph with a hand touching the screen for interactivity.

vocabulary.definition: Items arranged on a curved path.
A small black label showing a percent off.
A dish with the background removed.
A hand shown interacting with the screen.
